name: rules
content: Maximum five submissions per day, two final submissions, no multiple accounts, no hand labeling, public and reasonably accessible external data only.

name: Evaluation
content: score = adjusted_edge_jaccard + 0.1 * division_jaccard; patched division behavior is authoritative.

name: Timeline
content: Entry and merger deadline 2026-09-22 23:59 UTC; final deadline 2026-09-29 23:59 UTC.

name: Code Requirements
content: CPU and GPU notebooks must run within 12 hours, disable Internet, and write submission.csv.
